gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp and sturdy, a dark, heavy-looking band of text. Red Hat Display does its best work as a bold, marker-like headline with daylight in every curve, while Supreme earns its keep with a taller lowercase that stays open.
gen-almendra-display-gf-karla: Almendra Display brings an ornate, bookish flourish, its letters never pinching shut. And Karla sits beneath it, modern and approachable, with a gaping c and a tall middle band that makes each line look stocky.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-manrope: Contemporary and bold, Red Hat Display draws a marker-like line with daylight inside every curve. Manrope follows in a friendly sans-serif with bright, open mouths on its rounds, and a modest bump in its size lets those gaps breathe.
gen-almendra-display-gf-kedebideri: Kedebideri reads neutral and welcoming, its rounded letters staying open. Almendra Display and this sans share one real strength: both carry a lofty x-height, so ornate headline and plain text feel cut from the same tall cloth.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-satoshi: Satoshi reads approachable and soaring, its wide-open e never squeezed shut. Red Hat Display adds the bold, marker-like punch up top, so the plain sans below it can stay quiet and tall.
gen-almendra-display-gf-krub: Almendra Display is ornate and literary, its letters never pinching shut. Krub, a plain sans, does the contemporary, neutral work instead, leaving curves slightly unfinished where the heading stays fully rounded.
gen-almendra-display-gf-kufam: Kufam draws one tube-like line, clean and contemporary, with generously open curves in its e. Almendra Display brings the ornate, literary side, and that gap between flourish and uniform stroke is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-almendra-display-gf-lexend-deca: Lexend Deca reads clean and approachable, a plain sans whose unshaded line never swells and whose capitals look small beside big lowercase. Almendra Display handles the ornate part, so give it room.
gen-almendra-display-gf-liter: Ornate flourish meets a pipe-straight line. Liter then holds its tall lowercase and wide-mouthed rounds, with no stroke contrast at all, and that stark difference from Almendra Display is the pair's best quality.
gen-almendra-display-gf-mada: Ornate up top, towering below. But if Almendra Display gets made small, its literary charm fades, while a large Mada, a plain sans with curves that refuse to close, simply looks oversized.
